Aplicação de Política de Endpoint

The application of security controls to endpoints (e.g., laptops, mobiles) to ensure compliance with organizational security policies and prevent unauthorized access or activity.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Aplicação de Política de Endpoint?

In this glossary, Aplicação de Política de Endpoint refers to: The application of security controls to endpoints (e.g., laptops, mobiles) to ensure compliance with organizational security policies and prevent unauthorized access or activity.

How is Aplicação de Política de Endpoint used in cybersecurity?

In cybersecurity communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "A aplicação da política de endpoint garante que apenas dispositivos compatíveis acessem os recursos corporativos; endpoints não compatíveis são colocados em quarentena ou negados."

Definition

The application of security controls to endpoints (e.g., laptops, mobiles) to ensure compliance with organizational security policies and prevent unauthorized access or activity.

Operational example

Endpoint policy enforcement ensures only compliant devices access corporate resources; non-compliant endpoints are quarantined or denied.

Localized term

Aplicação de Política de Endpoint

Localized example
